name: 周炘賢
objective:
引導學生透過課堂上的遊戲、討論、體驗、演練等創意活動，從實作中學習設計思考的原理、過程與應用，進而反思自己所建構的設計思考方法。課程內容包含：設計主題、設計概念、靈感來源、空間功能、風格與材質、情感與氛圍等。
This course is to lead students a learning-by-doing fashion to help them understand the theories, processes, and application of design thinking by means of playing games, discussion, experience, and doing exercises at classroom, and accordingly, reflect their own approach to design thinking. The content of this course includes:
1.Design Theme (Theme)
2.Design Concept (Concept / Philosophy)
3.Inspiration (Inspiration)
4.Space Function (Functionality)
5.Style and Materials (Style & Materials)
6.Emotion and Atmosphere (Emotion & Atmosphere)
schedule: Each week, students will explore a different theme through hands-on activities. At the end of each class, they will present and share what they have learned and created during the session.
scorePolicy:
Course Assessment and Grading Criteria
Students will be evaluated based primarily on their work produced in each class, class participation, and attendance.
At the end of each class, students are expected to complete a design outcome related to the weekly theme. Their work will be evaluated based on completion, creativity, design thinking, and presentation skills.
Students’ participation in class, teamwork, discussion, and attendance will also be important factors in determining their overall course grade.
延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）
